description: Service worker script responsible for offline caching, handling install, activate, and fetch events to manage caching strategies for app shell, API requests, and navigation fallbacks.

methods.name: install
methods.description: Handles the installation of the service worker, caches the app shell files, and activates the worker immediately.

methods.name: activate
methods.description: Cleans up old caches on activation and takes control of the pages.

methods.name: fetch
methods.description: Intercepts network requests to implement different caching strategies for API calls, navigation requests, and static assets.

ctags.name: swSelf
ctags.pattern: /^const swSelf = self; \/\/ alias to satisfy some linters and clarity$/
